import SystemE
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
set_option linter.unnecessarySeqFocus false

namespace Elements.Book2

set_option systemE.solverTime 30 in
theorem helper_2_12_step3 (a b c d : Point)
  (step2 : |(d─c)| * |(d─c)| + |(d─b)| * |(d─b)| = |(c─a)| * |(c─a)| + |(a─d)| * |(a─d)| + |(d─b)| * |(d─b)| + 2 * (|(c─a)| * |(a─d)|))
  : |(c─d)| * |(c─d)| + |(d─b)| * |(d─b)| = |(c─a)| * |(c─a)| + |(a─d)| * |(a─d)| + |(d─b)| * |(d─b)| + 2 * (|(c─a)| * |(a─d)|) := by
  rw [segment_symmetric c d]
  linarith [step2]

end Elements.Book2

  (b c d : Point) (CA BC : Line)
  (hd_CA : d.onLine CA) (hc_CA : c.onLine CA)
  (hc_BC : c.onLine BC) (hb_BC : b.onLine BC)
  (hassump1 : ∠ b:d:c = ∟)
  : |(c─b)| * |(c─b)| = |(c─d)| * |(c─d)| + |(d─b)| * |(d─b)| := by
  euclid_apply (line_from_points d b) as DB
  euclid_apply (Elements.Book1.proposition_47 d c b CA BC DB)
  assumption

end Elements.Book2
